# EcclesiaOS v1.0.51

## Email provider routing

- Route password resets and application email notifications through the enabled provider configured in Administration → Communication Integrations → Email.
- Support church-specific provider settings with a global enabled-provider fallback.
- Apply church-specific branding to notification email templates.
- Route invitations, direct admin emails, campaign deliveries, and provider test emails through the configured email provider.
- Add provider validation and regression coverage for password reset and communication delivery paths.
